gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-comme: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies keeps every stem and arch at uniform heft, its bowls nearly sealed shut. But Comme runs smooth, its lowercase filling most of the letter height, so long text glides along.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-cossette-tex: Cossette Texte reads wide-eyed and clean, with a tall x-height. Jelly Crazies nearly seals its bowls and slows the pace to a stroll, while the open sans-serif body lets extended text move along briskly.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-duru-sans: Jelly Crazies is all closed-up wobble with strokes that never thin or swell. Duru Sans opens its small letters wide and lets the bodies dominate the line, so extended reading moves along at a much quicker step than the heading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-funnel-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully, its bowls nearly shut and its strokes never thinning. Funnel Sans is the opposite, its lowercase e pried open and its stroke widths holding steady from stem to curve.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat, its openings wide as a sprung paper clip and its words solid blocks. Jelly Crazies adds the wobble on top, and Geist holds the line.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-golos-text: Nearly sealed bowls give Jelly Crazies its wobbly, playful look. Golos Text brings a widely parted s and an x-height that fills the line, so the sans-serif body carries the reading while the heading carries the personality.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hedvig-lette: Playful and wobbly, Jelly Crazies is best loud, with strokes that never vary in weight. Hedvig Letters Sans does the quiet work, small letters standing nearly capital-tall around a wide-gapped c.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-guntur: Wobbly, playful and nearly sealed, Jelly Crazies is a heading made for loud moments. Hind Guntur does the opposite job, with wide gaps and tall, stamped-metal lowercase that hold a steady line.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-madurai: Wobbly and playful, Jelly Crazies nearly seals every bowl shut. Hind Madurai opens its s curves wide at both ends and fills the line like capitals, giving the heading plain company.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-hind-vadodar: Hind Vadodara stays clear and clean, with unchanging thickness and rounded glyphs that leave spacious terminal gaps. Jelly Crazies earns its keep when it is big, short and wobbly.
